summary: The model substantially diverges from the approved target. Facial construction and dorsal shields fail visually; arm clearance and every claw cannot be fully verified. The supplied deterministic report has no blockers and one warning, but the visual review fails.

findings.message: Supplied deterministic finding: height/depth ratio is 1.2748, below the 1.35 review threshold. This measurement alone does not establish a hunched posture.
findings.recommendation: Recheck the ratio after silhouette revisions, accounting for tail depth.

findings.message: The rectangular head, stacked rounded limb masses, narrow chest construction, and short segmented tail do not match the target's elongated reptilian head, integrated muscular armor, broad torso, and long curved tail. Yellow eyes and fractured armor accents are not visibly established.
findings.recommendation: Rebuild the primary anatomy and silhouette against the target before adding surface detail.

findings.message: The visible face consists of a broad rectangular slab, solid rectangular eye-area pieces, and projecting horizontal mouth wedges. It does not form the target's coherent reptilian crown, muzzle, and jaw. The overlay obscures part of the face, preventing full eye and vent verification.
findings.recommendation: Shape an elongated crown and muzzle with an integrated lower jaw; expose both eyes and vents in unobstructed close-ups.

findings.message: Both arms remain visible in the full-body views, but the close-ups crop the lower arms and hands and do not establish continuous clearance along the inner arm/torso boundaries. Full clearance cannot be verified; torso penetration is not conclusively demonstrated.
findings.recommendation: Capture each complete arm from shoulder to fingertips with the inner contour and torso separation visible.

findings.message: Both foot close-ups frame the lower legs and crop the toes. Wider views suggest forward front claws and rear projections, but cannot verify every claw's direction, attachment, exposure, and pointed shape on both feet.
findings.recommendation: Capture each entire foot from above and the side, showing all three front claws and the backward rear claw.

findings.message: The dorsal forms read as overlapping flat fins or slabs rather than the target's broad, irregular shattered storm shields. Seven distinct shield forms and their fractured surfaces cannot be verified.
findings.recommendation: Create seven clearly separated angular shield silhouettes with irregular broken edges and visible fracture accents.

criteria.reason: Anatomy, facial construction, proportions, armor treatment, and tail silhouette substantially differ from the approved target.
The slab-and-wedge face lacks coherent target anatomy; crown, jaw, vents, and both eyes cannot all be verified.
Available close-ups do not establish clearance along both complete arms. Unverifiable clearance fails the criterion.
Foot close-ups crop the claws; all eight required claws cannot be individually verified.
Front and side views show a vertical torso supported by the legs, with arms hanging clear of the ground.
A biped, dorsal ridge, and tail are present, but the target's distinctive reptilian head, armored anatomy, shield profile, and sweeping tail are not preserved.
Visible dorsal slabs lack the required shattered shield character; seven distinct forms cannot be confirmed.
Side views show bent digitigrade leg profiles, and front views show substantial thighs and lower legs visibly outweighing the short arms.
